_comment: Venues for the withdrawal-ability recorder (scripts/record-venue-liquidity.mjs). These are EXTERNAL mainnet venues (Ethereum), read via RECORDER_RPC_URL — NOT the local anvil. Entry shape: {name, kind, address, underlying?, decimals, enabled, newsQuery?, notes}. Only enabled=true venues are recorded. Never guess an address; leave it empty and enabled=false until verified. newsQuery (optional) is the Google News RSS search string for scripts/fetch-venue-news.mjs — a plain-English venue name, NOT a ticker, so headlines are about the protocol, not a random symbol collision.

venues.name: sUSDe
venues.notes: Ethena Staked USDe (mainnet). underlying = USDe. Reads: cooldownDuration() uint24, totalAssets(), totalSupply(), silo() if present. cooling/stranded split is venue-specific and NOT fabricated here — raw params stored, instant_usd left null with a note.

venues.name: aave-v3-usde
venues.notes: aEthUSDe, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: Aave V3 Pool (0x87870Bca…4fA4E2).getReserveData(USDe) returned this address; it answers symbol()='aEthUSDe' and UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS()=USDe. instant liquidity = USDe.balanceOf(aToken) at $1/stable (assumption recorded in params).

venues.name: sUSDS
venues.notes: Sky Savings USDS, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: symbol()='sUSDS', asset()=USDS (0xdC03…384F), totalAssets ~$4.7B at verification. No cooldown method — those reads fail gracefully and raw 4626 state (totalAssets/totalSupply) is what gets recorded.

venues.name: scrvUSD
venues.notes: Curve Savings crvUSD, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: symbol()='scrvUSD', asset()=crvUSD (0xf939…1b4E), totalAssets ~$15.8M at verification. Same graceful-read behavior as sUSDS.
